arena.info_p1_html: ChasFlip runs on a dynamic smart pool integrated with Supabase: the live pool concentrates table activity and keeps balances and movements coherent and centralized for every player.
arena.info_p2_pre_link: Each round you play, the engine targets a result that is fast on the experience and verifiable later — it stays as a ticket you can copy: nobody on this screen can change who won once the bet is locked. With wallet connected, on the
arena.info_p2_post_link: you see the same public information as everyone else.
arena.info_p3_html: And “VRF”? In crypto it's the standard way of getting randomness third-party reviewable. If you don't care about details: the idea is honesty with proof, not technology against you.
